PASS only if ALL of the following hold:
- A compact scenario map or equivalent prompt structure retains case distinctions and conditional logic.
- The response preserves: Each material prospect and scenario.
- The response preserves: Conditional requirements, dependencies, exceptions, deadlines, output formats.

- Dropping exceptions or dependencies.
